connectBody.message: Start and stop your time in the browser and assign it to clients and projects.

verifiedNotice.message: The official Fin3000 extension sends explicitly selected element text as a description. It reads only your timer and permitted clients and projects.

scope.message: Read, start, edit, stop and discard your own time

permissionDenied.message: You do not have the required time tracking permission.

manualCapture.message: This element cannot be captured. Enter the description manually.

dirtyStop.message: Stop records the saved values. Unsaved changes remain as a draft.

taskCleared.message: Changing the project removes the previous task.

discardConfirm.message: Discard this timer? No time entry will be created.

conflict.message: The timer changed in the meantime. Refresh and check its current state.

expiredAction.message: This action expired. Check the current timer before starting a new action.

longTimer.message: More than 24 hours recorded. Please check the entry in Fin3000.

storageError.message: Local storage is unavailable. Reopen the extension.

rateLimited.message: Please wait and refresh the status later.

connectAgain.message: Reconnect the extension. A running timer keeps running.

captureReady.message: The selected text is ready. Check the person and start explicitly.

disconnected.message: Disconnected. A running timer keeps running.

checking.message: Receipt is being checked. Please do not send again.

extensionDescription.message: Start and stop your time in the browser and assign it to clients and projects.
